label: SUNDAY QUIZ
hook: 3 quick questions on emergency funds. Ready?

slides.text: Q1: An emergency fund is for… a sale, a holiday, or a sudden medical bill?
Q2: Essentials cost ₹20,000 a month. A 3-month fund is…?
Q3: Keep it mixed with spending money, or separate and easy to reach?
slides.sub: Answer: separate and easy to reach

slides.text: It makes a sudden bill something you can handle.
